title: Direton - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Direton in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Direton is a earth-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Agility (D), Luck (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Direton
sections.content:
Location: Falling Leaves merchant.

Obtained from Falling Leaves merchant.

sections.title: Is the Direton Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (D), Luck (C). A dedicated earth pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
